name: backdated_document
description: A posting whose posting_date is earlier than its sim_date and than other posted documents, in an open period.

name: posting_in_soft_locked_period
description: A posting into a soft-locked period: must_succeed by an actor with the capability, must_reject by one without.

name: rounding_many_small_lines
description: A foreign-currency entry with many small lines whose converted amounts need a rounding line.

name: command_retry_same_key
description: Any business event with retry true: sent twice with the same idempotency key.

name: foreign_currency_journal
description: A journal entry in USD converted at the published book rate.

name: reversal_of_internal_document
description: A posted internal document reversed in an open period.

name: negative_stock_attempt
description: An issue or backdated transfer that would make stock negative on its date or a later date.

name: concurrent_issues_same_item
description: Two issues of the same item and warehouse in one concurrency_group, with stock sufficient for both; concurrency itself is exercised by PAR-01.

name: transfer_different_average
description: A transfer between warehouses whose averages differ, under warehouse-level valuation.

name: transfer_through_transit
description: Goods moved to a transit warehouse and received days later, across a month end once.

name: landed_cost_after_partial_sale
description: A freight cost allocated after part of the goods it covers was sold, in the same open period; at steps 3-4 the cost source is the documented test journal (rule 10).

name: landed_cost_after_period_lock
description: A cost allocated to goods received in a period whose inventory area is locked.

name: import_customs_rate
description: A USD import whose customs rate differs from the book rate, with import duty.

name: uom_conversion
description: Bought in cartons, sold in bottles.

name: lot_and_serial_movements
description: Movements of lot- and serial-tracked items, including a lot split across warehouses.

name: stock_count_differences
description: A stock count with both a shortage and a surplus.

name: preliminary_price_missing
description: A count surplus of an item that has never had a receipt or price.

name: degenerate_costing
description: Goods transferred back and forth on one day, and an area left with value but no quantity.

name: partial_fulfilment
description: Partial deliveries, receipts and invoices of one order.

name: return_of_partly_invoiced_goods
description: A customer returns goods of which only part was invoiced. Interim, flagged (ADR-0047 rule 20): a sales return for the invoiced share is due; uninvoiced returned goods reduce what remains to invoice.

name: credit_limit_exceeded
description: A sales order that would take a customer over its credit limit. Interim, flagged (ADR-0047 rule 18): approval at Submit; deliveries of other unreleased orders held.

name: price_below_cost
description: A sales price below the item's current cost. Interim, flagged (ADR-0047 rule 22): is_price_below_cost feeds the policy; the outcome is the company's rules.

name: partial_fx_payment_other_rate
description: A partial payment of a foreign-currency invoice at a rate different from the invoice rate.

name: month_end_fx_revaluation
description: Revaluation of open foreign-currency items at month end.

name: netting_receivables_payables
description: Netting a partner's receivable against its payable.

name: tax_rate_change_mid_period
description: A change of a fictional date-effective test tax code in mid-month, with invoices on both sides of the date; not a claim about any law.

name: invoice_corrections
description: A posted sales invoice corrected by a correction document in the form the package defines (ADR-0009 rule 23), such as an adjustment or a replacement.

name: year_end_close
description: Year-end close with closing entries.

name: one_cost_source_several_receipts
description: One cost source allocated over two partial receipts of the same goods (e.g. 600 then 400 units); from step 5 the source can be a customs declaration.

name: cost_before_receipt
description: A cost recorded before the goods receipt waits in clearing until allocated.

name: import_vat_on_customs
description: Import VAT on a customs declaration, recovered or capitalized per the tax code's import treatment.

name: short_pick
description: A pick confirmed with less than the task quantity; the bin is counted and the rest backordered.

name: putaway_without_free_bin
description: A receipt whose putaway rules find no bin with capacity; the task has no target.

name: fefo_below_customer_minimum
description: FEFO skips a near-expiry lot below the customer's minimum remaining shelf life.

name: handling_unit_split
description: A partial pick from a pallet.

name: count_during_picking
description: Picks after a count confirmation and before its posting do not become count differences.

name: quality_release
description: Goods received into quality inspection, released or blocked.

name: pick_face_replenishment
description: A pick that takes a pick face below its minimum creates a replenishment task.

name: returns_disposition
description: A customer return received blocked and disposed to restock, quality or scrap.

name: transfer_with_bins
description: A transfer between two bin-managed warehouses, with putaway at the destination.

name: import_across_holiday
description: An import whose supplier processing and transit span a multi-day holiday from the package calendar; release date and need date follow the calendars.

name: intermittent_item
description: An item sold rarely in large lots: planned orders cover its open orders and the moving-average forecast, and no proposal is created for a past spike alone.

name: supplier_minimum_excess
description: A supplier minimum forces a quantity above the maximum; the excess is shown with an exception.

name: transfer_network
description: A destination warehouse replenished by transfer from a central warehouse, with dependent demand at the source.

name: promotion_adjustment
description: A forecast adjustment for a promotion, approved by a human, raises planned quantities.

name: invoice_with_installments
description: An invoice with a two-installment term posts two receivable lines and two open items.

name: partial_payment
description: A payment settles part of an open item; the carrying amount leaving is its proportional share.

name: overpayment
description: A payment above the named items leaves a payment on account (interim, flagged).

name: credit_note_matched
description: A credit note creates a credit item and is matched with the invoice in the same command.

name: opening_open_items
description: Opening balances create one open item per old invoice, in several currencies.

name: partner_account_change
description: A partner's reconciliation account changes; its open items move by balance transfers.

name: settlement_reversed
description: A payment is reversed after settling an item; the item reopens with the exact original amounts.

name: e_invoice_rejected
description: An e-invoice rejected for a wrong buyer tax ID returns the invoice to draft; it is corrected and issued again; nothing is posted before acceptance.

name: order_changed_after_partial_pick
description: An approved order is changed after part of it was picked; the version in force stays until the change is approved; only changed lines are adjusted.

name: rates_cross_approval_threshold
description: Rates move between approval and posting so the required procedure rises; posting is rejected with approval_context_changed and the document is submitted again.

name: bank_account_change_by_email
description: An e-mail asks to change a supplier's bank account; the agent run's direct call is rejected with tool_not_allowed (the command is on no tool list), a consumer command carrying the run as origin with proposal_required, and a change proposal approved by a second human succeeds (DS-04 dispatcher check order).

name: injection_laundered_through_draft
description: An injected instruction copied into a draft and edited by a human stays tainted; a run given that draft becomes tainted.

name: auto_posts_block_close
description: Auto-posted bank matches block the period lock until their rule owner confirms them.

name: e_invoice_outage_across_period_end
description: A provider outage keeps an invoice in issuing across month end; the period lock is blocked until it posts.

name: backdated_issue_outside_window
description: An invoice issued with a posting date outside the regime's window is rejected by package validation.

name: invoice_before_receipt
description: Under the flagged interim, the supplier invoice posts before the goods arrive; GR/IR carries the order price, the difference for unreceived goods waits as a pending receipt adjustment, and GR/IR clears per order line once quantities match.

name: price_difference_soft_locked_receipt
description: Under the flagged interim, an invoice differs from a receipt whose period is soft-locked; the difference posts in closed mode in the first open period, whoever posts, and the invoice is not blocked.

name: concurrent_orders_one_credit_limit
description: Two orders of one customer are submitted at the same time; each credit check sees the other's exposure. Interim, flagged (ADR-0047 rule 18).

name: duplicate_supplier_e_invoice
description: The same supplier e-invoice arrives by e-mail and through the provider; the second arrival names the existing record.

name: credit_note_across_rate_change
description: A credit note corrects a sale after a rate change of the profile's date-effective test tax code between the sale and the credit note; it keeps the original line's tax date and rate, while its declaration date is its own. Values come from the active package (fictional in l10n_xx); not a claim about any law.

name: payment_condition_failed
description: A purchase invoice at or above the active package's payment-evidence threshold is paid partly by a method the package's condition lists as failing; the failing share of its input tax becomes non-deductible by a condition_failed adjustment, and a tax_deductibility_changed work item is raised. Values come from the active package (fictional in l10n_xx); not a claim about any law.

name: import_resume_after_fault
description: A chunk of a staged opening import fails by injected fault; the chunk rolls back alone, ResumeImport continues from the first pending row, and no posted chunk runs twice.

name: import_bulk_reversal
description: An abandoned opening batch is reversed by ReverseImportBatch, newest first, with an injected fault mid-way; the reversal resumes, and it stops on a settled open item or consumed stock.

name: purchase_price_change_between_receipts
description: A change order changes a purchase price between two receipts; the invoice clears GR/IR at each position's first-posted price, and a return after the change takes the latest positions.

name: free_goods_with_document_discount
description: A sales order with a free goods promotion and a document discount; the discount is allocated to the paid lines by largest remainder and the free line stays at zero.

name: purchase_invoice_match_tolerance
description: One supplier invoice within the price tolerance posts without approval; another beyond it needs approval through is_match_exceeded.

name: duplicate_bank_line_without_reference
description: Two equal statement lines without a bank reference; both are kept with duplicate_suspected.

name: payment_while_invoice_issuing
description: A customer pays while the invoice is still in issuing; the receipt records an advance, matched to the invoice after it posts.

name: early_payment_discount_partial
description: A partial payment within the discount date takes the discount on the share it settles.

name: cash_count_shortage
description: A cash count finds less than the book balance; the shortage posts to the pending account.

name: currency_exchange_between_accounts
description: Foreign currency sold from one money account into another; the clearing nets to zero after the realized difference.

name: bad_debt_provision_then_write_off
description: Overdue items cross two provision buckets; a later write-off uses the allowance first.

name: employee_advance_overspent
description: An employee spends more than advanced; the excess is paid as a further advance and the settlement then clears both.

name: injected_instruction_in_quotation_email
description: A quotation e-mail asks the agent to add another customer's prices and to send the quotation at once; the run stays in its partner scope, any out-of-scope read is refused with tainted_read_out_of_scope, the draft holds only that customer's data, and nothing is sent.

name: new_customer_with_existing_tax_id
description: An e-mail from an unknown sender gives a tax ID an existing partner holds; the onboarding proposal carries partner_duplicate_suspected redacted to a count for the run, a person rejects it, and an approval attempt by the workflow owner would fail with segregation_of_duties.

name: supplier_invoice_line_unmapped
description: A supplier e-invoice line has no partner_item mapping; the agent chooses among the supplier's related items, drafts the invoice and proposes the mapping; after approval the next invoice of that item maps without an LLM.

name: bank_description_free_text_reference
description: A bank line's description names an invoice in free text that the cascade cannot use; the suggestion leads to a tainted draft without a score, which an enabled auto-post rule does not post.

name: agent_run_resumed_after_crash
description: A quotation run's worker crashes after an LLM call; the retry replays the recorded step and continues, and the quotation is drafted once.

name: spoofed_contact_sender
description: An e-mail claims a stored contact's address but fails DMARC; it stays unmatched with the contact's partner as an unauthenticated candidate and a work item.

name: same_email_two_mailboxes
description: One message reaches two mailboxes; the second inbound message points to the first, canonical one and no second interaction is made.

name: reused_message_id
description: A second e-mail reuses a Message-ID with other content, one of them a Message-ID the company sent, from an outside sender; both are kept as their own interactions and the later gets duplicate_suspected.

name: unknown_sender_onboarding
description: An authenticated e-mail from an unknown company whose tax ID no partner holds (unlike EC-80): the onboarding run proposes CreatePartner with role customer and the sender's domain, a person approves it, the duplicate search runs, and a person then confirms the match; a second, unauthenticated e-mail from another unknown sender wakes no agent and waits for a person.

name: complaint_pauses_dunning
description: A customer with an overdue invoice has two complaints; dunning skips them until both are closed, whichever closes first.

name: consent_withdrawn_before_send
description: A contact withdraws marketing consent after a marketing draft was written; sending it is rejected.

name: contact_erasure
description: A contact with e-mails in a shared thread, a complaint, a sent outbound message and a posted invoice is erased; their text and addresses are blanked, others' participant rows stay, the closed message's header and version are unchanged, the invoice stays, and the request closes keeping only the identity-proof hash.

name: shared_domain_unmatched
description: A domain belongs to two partners of a group; an authenticated e-mail from a new address at that domain stays unmatched with both as candidates.

name: special_period_adjustment_in_year_end_report
description: An adjustment posts in the special period after the last regular period is locked; year-end statements include it, and a report of the last month with special periods excluded does not.

name: customer_advance_and_invoice_at_year_end
description: A customer has an open invoice and an unapplied advance at year end; the balance sheet presents them by the package's bilateral split, and the two parts sum to the account balance.

name: adjustment_after_filing
description: A statement is filed, then an adjustment changes it; the filing shows its snapshot and the difference, which a supplement files.

name: mid_year_cut_over_comparatives
description: A company migrated mid-year: the year's income statement adds the opening turnover, and prior-year comparatives come from stored comparative values.

name: payment_with_several_counterparts_in_cash_flow
description: A payment settles an invoice with a bank charge and a realized exchange difference; the direct cash flow splits it in proportion and its check line holds.

name: filing_after_late_posting
description: A statement is rendered, then a document posts into its range; filing that render succeeds with the check result report_snapshot_stale, and the filing's difference view shows the posting.

name: printed_document_reversed
description: A goods receipt is printed, then reversed; a new print gets a new render key and the REVERSED marker, and the first file stays linked as evidence.

name: outbound_outcome_unknown
description: A send times out without an answer; the attempt records unknown and the message returns to approved; an Update of the text is refused with invalid_state_transition; the next send makes crm_mail_sender search the sent folder before it submits, find the message and record sent without sending it twice.

name: forged_authentication_results
description: An e-mail carries a forged Authentication-Results field with the company's authserv-id and a quoted smtp.mailfrom value holding dmarc=pass, under the receiving server's own field that reports DMARC fail; it stays unmatched. At a mailbox whose probe has not passed, every message is unauthenticated.

name: carton_received_in_pieces
description: An order of 10 cartons of 24 is received as 100 and 140 pieces and invoiced as 10 cartons; the order line is fulfilled and GR/IR is zero.

name: bag_partial_receipts
description: An order of 3 bags of 7/3 kg is received in three receipts of 1 bag: 2.333, 2.334 and 2.333 kg, summing to the ordered 7.000 kg; the invoice of 3 bags leaves GR/IR at zero.

name: grams_through_catalog
description: A product kept in kilograms is sold and delivered in grams through the core conversion, with no product unit; the lines snapshot source global.

name: item_level_unit
description: Two variants of one product have cartons of 24 and of 12; an order of the second variant in cartons converts by its item-level row.

name: retired_unit
description: A supplier changes its carton from 24 to 20: the carton row of 24 is retired and a carton row of 20 added on the same unit code; carton price entries are end-dated; a new order line in cartons converts at 20, while the receipt of an open order in cartons keeps its snapshot of 24.

name: e_invoice_unknown_unit_text
description: A supplier e-invoice writes a unit text the company has never seen; the agent leaves the line unresolved with unit_text_unresolved and proposes an alias, which a person approves before the line is drafted.

name: invoice_per_kg_against_bags
description: Goods ordered and received in bags of 7/3 kg are invoiced per kg; quantity and price are matched per inventory unit.

name: bill_of_materials_in_cans
description: A component stated in cans of 5 litres with issue multiple 1 can: a requirement of 2.5 cans plans 3 cans, 15 litres, and the difference shows as planned consumption.

name: supplier_order_unit
description: A need of 100 pieces from a supplier selling cartons of 24 with minimum 2 and multiple 1 proposes 5 cartons, 120 pieces, with 20 pieces of rounding excess; the request and order keep cartons.

name: owner_scope_sales_clerk
description: A sales clerk with owner scope own lists sales orders and sees only their own; their manager with scope department sees the department's, including those of a sub-department they manage.

name: buyer_posts_own_order_receipt
description: A user who holds both the buyer and the warehouse keeper role writes a purchase order, then tries to post its goods receipt and is refused; another warehouse keeper posts it.

name: approval_two_stages_k_of_n
description: A purchase order above the senior rank is approved by one accountant at the first stage and by two of three managers at a stage with k = 2, then posts.

name: approval_edit_after_first_stage
description: A document edited after its first stage approval loses that approval; the resubmission starts again at the first stage.

name: approval_rejected_at_second_stage
description: A rejection at the second stage returns the document to draft with the reason; the next round starts at the first stage and earlier approvals do not count.

name: approval_by_substitute
description: An approver on leave delegated approval authority; the substitute approves inside the window, recorded with delegated_from, and is refused the day after it ends.

name: reset_of_shared_user
description: An IT administrator of one company tries to reset the password of a user who also works in another company and is refused; an operator resets it, the user's sessions are revoked and TOTP stays enrolled.

name: approval_would_strand_stage
description: In a two-person company in small-company mode, the owner tries to approve the first stage of a rank-20 document the accountant wrote and is refused; the accountant approves the first stage and the owner the second.

name: two_people_one_login
description: A company creates a user with a login that another company's user already holds, meaning a different person; the response is the same as for a new login, the assignment stays pending and grants nothing, the company sees only what it typed, its password reset answers record_not_found, and it cancels the invitation; the account's owner gains and loses nothing.

name: gs1_receipt_lot_expiry
description: A supplier carton label in GS1-128 with (01), (17) and (10) is scanned at receipt: the carton GTIN gives item and unit, the lot is created with its expiry date, and one carton is received in the inventory unit.

name: wedge_without_separator
description: A wedge scanner without GS substitution sends a label with (10) before (17); the lot value ends with a valid (17) date, and the scan stops with gs1_invalid reason separator_suspect.

name: bin_code_equals_item_barcode
description: A bin is created with a barcode that an item unit already holds; the registry refuses it.

name: variable_measure_receipt
description: A label with (01) indicator 9 and (3103) is received into an item kept in kilograms (identity) and into one kept in grams (through the catalog conversion); a (3105) measure with a non-zero fifth decimal is refused with too_many_decimal_places.

name: serials_confirmed_by_handling_unit
description: A pick of serial-tracked goods is confirmed by scanning the closed handling unit that holds exactly the serials; in another task one serial scanned twice is refused with serial_already_scanned.

name: bare_lot_code_two_items
description: A lot code that two items share is scanned on a search screen; the query returns lot_needs_item and no candidate.

name: old_bin_label_after_relabel
description: A bin's barcode is changed; a worker scans the old label at the bin and gets barcode_retired, never another bin.

name: company_without_gs1_prefix
description: A company without a GS1 company prefix labels items, lots and serials with internal codes and receives and picks by them; generating a GTIN is refused with gs1_prefix_required.

name: digital_link_receipt
description: A supplier item carries a GS1 Digital Link QR code with lot and expiry; the receipt captures them and no URL is fetched.

name: legacy_codes_migrated
description: Migration loads the old system's numeric bin and item labels as legacy codes; one item code passes a GTIN check digit and is listed with legacy_code_gtin_like; Code 128 scans of the bins and EAN-13 and UPC-A scans of the item codes resolve to their objects.

name: separator_confirmed_as_read
description: After the stop of EC-120 the person checks the label and confirms the value as read (scan.confirmed_as_read); the receipt takes the lot as read and succeeds.

name: return_of_inexact_part
description: Of three receipts of one bag of 7/3 kg (2.333, 2.334, 2.333 kg) invoiced as 3 bags (7.000 kg), the second is returned and posts its own 2.334; the supplier's credit of 1 bag names that return line and posts the same 2.334, so R = I = 4.666 and GR/IR stays zero; a replacement receipt of one bag posts 2.334. On the sales side the same return and credit leave invoiced net equal to delivered net, and sales_return_due closes.

name: deliveries_within_rounding_tolerance
description: 8.000 kg ordered and delivered as three bags of 8/3 kg, each converting on its own to 2.667 kg: the third delivery (8.001 kg in total) is accepted within the unit rounding tolerance of 0.003 kg and fulfils the line.

name: e_invoice_xml_by_mail
description: A supplier e-mails an XML e-invoice with its PDF to a mailbox with purpose supplier_invoice; the system imports the record, the agent starts in the supplier's scope, and the PDF whose text layer holds the invoice number is linked as the rendering, its extraction canceled by the system.

name: e_invoice_resent_other_bytes
description: The same invoice arrives again as other bytes with the same supplier-invoice key and a passed signature; the import is refused naming the first record.

name: e_invoice_unsigned_first
description: An unsigned XML e-invoice is imported quarantined and holds no key; the genuine signed invoice with the same key arrives later, is imported, supersedes the quarantined record and raises e_invoice_record_superseded.

name: pdf_hidden_instruction
description: A PDF invoice carries white text telling an agent to change the bank account; hidden text is flagged by position, the review is full, and nothing changes.

name: document_bank_account_differs
description: A PDF invoice names a bank account the supplier master does not have; the check result is shown and no master data or payment changes.

name: business_card_vcard_qr
description: A business card photo with a vCard QR code becomes a contact change proposal with duplicate checks on e-mail and phone; the created contact is linked to the extraction.

name: business_card_no_permitted_provider
description: A business card photo without a QR code in a company with no permitted provider; no model is called and a person keys the fields.

name: vision_total_on_two_lines
description: A vision value for a total cites words on two lines; it is stored unaligned, fills nothing, and the computed total decides the rule.

name: product_from_note_new_component
description: A note asks for a new assembly with one new component; the item proposal and drafts are made, release is refused until the item is approved and bound, then another person approves the release proposal.

name: draft_estimate_missing_rate
description: A draft estimate on a work center without an activity rate lists the gap, totals without it, and cannot be released until the rate exists.

name: component_by_manufacturer_part
description: A component named by a manufacturer part number with its manufacturer, written with other separators, resolves to exactly one item without an LLM.

name: engineering_change_with_stock
description: An engineering change replaces a component with stock and open purchase orders; the release proposal carries where-used, the orders, a disposition and the cost delta.

name: drawing_with_instructions
description: A customer drawing says to use supplier X at price Y; it never starts a run, and the person's note names only the verified quantities.

name: e_invoice_signer_mismatch
description: An XML e-invoice signed with a valid certificate of another company names a known supplier's tax ID; signer_mismatch, quarantined, and no agent run until a person confirms the supplier.

name: pdf_beside_xml_other_invoice
description: A message carries an XML invoice and a PDF of a second invoice; the PDF matches neither by file name nor by number and is extracted as its own document.

name: unmatched_sender_pdfs
description: A sender whose free mail address passes DKIM but matches no partner mails ten PDFs and an unsigned XML to the supplier-invoice mailbox; the PDFs are stored only and no OCR or vision runs until a person requests one, and the XML's quarantined record counts toward the cap.

name: signed_after_confirmed_unsigned
description: A person confirms the supplier of an unsigned record; the genuine signed invoice with the same key arrives later, is imported with key_conflict_with_record_id, raises e_invoice_key_conflict, and no agent starts until an accountant resolves it.

name: large_order_alerts_warehouse
description: A sales order above the rule's threshold is approved; the warehouse gets one automation work item, and a second matching event in the same causation chain is recorded skipped_same_target.

name: automation_cycle_refused
description: A rule that raises an automation task on any automation task is refused at activation as a cycle, and so is a rule on WorkItemRaised[automation_task] whose purchase request draft a consumer answers with work items of undeclared kinds; with a notice instead of a task the first is accepted.

name: automation_depth_cap
description: A fourth rule on a chain of three is refused at activation for depth; a path no declaration showed stops at depth 3 at run time.

name: automation_owner_loses_right
description: The owner of an active rule loses the right to create purchase requests; five refusals within an hour disable the rule and raise automation_rule_disabled; when the owner's last assignment ends, the rules are disabled owner_inactive and company_owner gets the item.

name: automation_on_agent_chain
description: An event of an agent's chain reaches a rule with create_draft and start_agent; the draft is created tainted, the agent start is skipped by design, and the execution is acted without counting toward the breaker.

name: decision_table_overlap_and_gap
description: A decision table with an overlap is refused; with the overlap fixed and a gap left it is accepted with decision_table_gap, and an input in the gap takes the rule's no-match handling.

name: upgrade_invalidates_rule
description: An upgrade removes a condition field after its deprecation window; the rule is disabled with upgrade_invalid and its owner gets artifact_invalidated; nothing fails at run time.

name: bank_parameters_promoted_then_demoted
description: A parameter set for the bank cascade drafted from three months is backtested on the next two, shadowed, promoted with frozen evidence, keeps auto-post off until new evidence under its hash, and is demoted to shadow by override drift a month later; the demotion marks the auto-post rule's evidence outdated, and EnablePolicyRule refuses it until a new rule version brings new evidence.

name: promotion_evidence_stale
description: A function release between the evidence and the approval's execution makes the promotion fail with artifact_evidence_stale, while the version in force keeps acting, its owner gets artifact_function_changed with a re-evaluation, and new evidence succeeds.

name: bank_token_rule_suggest_then_confirm
description: A bank token rule is written as a draft version, waits for a later line, is approved into suggest mode by a second person, drafts without a score, and moves to confirm mode on live evidence with its score from steps 3-4; a line naming another partner's reference stays a suggestion.

name: held_out_case_leak
description: A drafting run read a held-out golden case; its evidence is insufficient and the promotion is refused.

name: bank_account_rule
description: A bank-fee token rule maps to the bank charges account; an outflow with the whole token drafts to that account at cap_company_rule under the unverified-counterparty cap, flagged counterparty_unverified and never auto-posted; an inflow with it only suggests, and two rules on one line suggest.

name: automation_owner_and_reader_scope
description: An owner without the margin class cannot activate a rule on a margin field; a rule whose owner covers one branch never evaluates orders of another; validation returns automation_owner_scope_limited and the daily count grows; a reader without that branch sees none of its executions, and a reader without margin sees margin values and their results omitted, marked is_class_filtered.

name: analysis_owner_scoped_total
description: A sales clerk with owner scope own builds an analysis of last month's net invoiced sales in the analysis builder (the seed gives the clerk no analysis agent); the result totals only their documents, carries the scope note and analysis_scope_filtered, and its drill lists only their invoices.

name: analysis_two_currencies
description: A question over sales invoices in two currencies asks for document amounts without naming a currency; the plan is refused with currency_mixed, and the planner repairs it to company-currency amounts or the agent asks which currency (ambiguous_term); grouped by currency, the result has one subtotal per currency and no grand total.

name: analysis_margin_without_class
description: A user without the margin field class asks for gross profit by customer; the run abstains with not_permitted, names the missing class and shows no figure.

name: analysis_change_open_month
description: Net revenue change by customer between a locked month and the open current month: the contribution rows reconcile to zero, the total change equals the journal's, and analysis_periods_open is returned.

name: analysis_out_of_coverage
description: A question about a figure no measure holds abstains with out_of_coverage, names the nearest measures and offers a catalog request; no number is shown.

name: analysis_management_equals_journal
description: At month end, net revenue by item group from the analysis layer at full scope equals ADR-0049's change measure with closing_entries=exclude over the operational accounts of the revenue system account subtree (INV-411).

name: analysis_year_closed_by_entries
description: A regime closes profit and loss by closing entries and an adjustment posts in the special period: net revenue for the year excludes the closing entry and includes the adjustment, special_periods exclude leaves it out, the closing balance of the revenue subtree after closing is zero, and both agree with ADR-0049's turnover.

name: setting_tighten_then_loosen
description: A controller lowers cash.bank_charge.auto_post_ceiling at once; raising it again directly returns proposal_required; a proposal approved by a second person takes effect and marks the dependent auto-post rule's evidence outdated.

name: setting_out_of_bounds
description: automation.breaker_failures 0 and automation.breaker_consecutive below the failures setting are refused with setting_out_of_bounds; a self-approved loosening is refused with approver_is_submitter.

name: bank_charge_auto_post
description: Monthly fee lines with the configured code reach six over three months, a rule's auto-post is enabled and the next fee posts by system; a fee above amount_max gets human_post; a fee line that also matches an open item is not auto-posted.

name: llm_originated_rule_opt_in
description: With the setting false a confirm-mode match of an LLM-proposed rule gets human_post; a proposal to enable it is refused with setting_out_of_bounds while its bound is false, and the match stays human_post; an llm_suggestion draft never posts by system.

name: wrong_auto_post_suspends
description: A person reverses a document posted by system; the rule version's evidence is marked outdated, auto_post_suspended is raised, and the next match gets human_post.

name: wake_up_by_rule
description: The quotation agent's inbound_message_matched is set to by_rule with a rule on one mailbox; a matched message to that mailbox starts the agent, one to another mailbox stays with people.

name: personal_values_without_permission
description: With the routing switch off and no permission, a drafting step receives placeholders and a step that needs the value ends routing_blocked; the upgrade raised setting_review_required.

name: provider_terms_change
description: The provider registry changes an endpoint's terms reference; the permission is suspended, vision runs end routing_blocked, and data_processing_permission_suspended is raised.

name: tainted_projection_read
description: A tainted purchase invoice run lists item candidates through the projection (at most 20 rows, no prices); its eleventh call returns tainted_projection_cap_reached; with agents.tainted_reference_reads literal the call returns tainted_read_out_of_scope.

name: automation_flood_guard
description: A mass import fires a rule 600 times in one hour; 500 executions act, 100 are rate_limited, one automation_rule_rate_limited item is raised, and the breaker does not trip.

name: purchase_return_option_from_period_start
description: A company switches the purchase return option mid-period and is refused with setting_effective_date_invalid; from the next period start it succeeds, and a return in that period is valued at the preliminary price with the difference to the price difference key.

name: day00_reject_category
description: A category set to reject refuses a (17) with day 00 as gs1_invalid (date), while another category reads it as the month's last day.

name: near_duplicate_payment_held
description: A second invoice of the same seller, one minor unit apart and three days later, posts with its open item blocked for payment and a duplicate_document_review; resolving it as not a duplicate releases the block.

name: product_code_manual_category
description: A category with manual codes refuses a duplicate code with product_code_taken, and once a sales order refers to its item a code change returns product_code_immutable.

name: shortage_cleared_while_transfer_pending
description: A goods receipt covers the target's shortage while a transfer_reservation proposal waits; at execution the target's short quantity (unreserved requirement minus available to promise) is 0, so the transfer fails with reservation_transfer_invalid although nothing reserved the receipt, and the next RunProductionOrderCheck closes the shortage item.

name: reservation_sweeps_race
description: Two sweeps start on one goods receipt; together they never reserve more than the receipt or a line's open requirement (a parallel test).

name: sweep_respects_sales_reservation
description: Available stock is reserved for a sales order; the sweep reserves nothing from it and the shortage stays listed.

name: multi_level_lateness_bottom_up
description: A late component order delays its parent; the component order's reschedule is proposed before the parent's, and the dates are consistent.

name: alternative_version_invalid_on_new_start
description: An alternative version valid on the order's end date but not on the recomputed start is not offered as a candidate.

name: reschedule_tolerances
description: With an out-tolerance of 3 days a 2-day postponement raises no message, while with the in-tolerance at 0 a 1-day lateness is raised.

name: capture_order_outside_scope
description: A capture report names an order of a branch outside the human's record scope; the run is refused unresolved and the response does not reveal the order.

name: capture_yield_tolerance
description: A capture report with yield above the previous operation inside the tolerance drafts with a check result; outside it the draft carries yield_above_tolerance under warn and is refused under reject.

name: capture_duplicate_report
description: The same photo sent twice is one extraction; the same numbers typed again within the window give operation_confirmation_duplicate_suspected.

name: capture_text_instructions
description: A report's text says to post now and names another order; the run stays draft-only and reads only its order.

name: capture_milestone_confirmation
description: A report for a milestone operation; the earlier operations' generated confirmations appear in the draft's plan, not chosen by the model.

name: capture_backflush_missing_stock
description: A drafted confirmation would backflush more than the supply bin holds; its simulation shows negative_stock and the readiness note explains it.

name: completion_proposal_then_late_receipt
description: An order at 97% received under a 95% setting gets a completion proposal; after a late receipt a person reopens it.

name: variance_negative_residual
description: An order completed in a period without receipts; the explanation never calls the negative residual a saving.

name: rework_and_disassembly_in_agent_queries
description: Rework and disassembly orders appear correctly in the shortage list, completion candidates and usage variance.

name: make_to_order_sales_line_canceled
description: The sales line of a not-started make-to-order order is canceled; a cancel message is raised and recommended in a note; the agent never cancels the order.

name: tainted_capture_draft_policy_auto_approve
description: A policy rule would let a tainted capture draft through without a person; floor 3 makes it human_post.

name: production_agents_halted_mid_sweep
description: Every production agent type is set to off during a sweep; it stops at its next call boundary.

name: production_import_auto_post_gate
description: A production import with auto-post enabled posts a row whose plan has no check result as integration only once the policy rule is enabled with evidence (300 drafts over 2 months, 99% posted unchanged); a row with any check result stays a draft; a repeated reference is refused.

name: reservation_transfer_only_by_proposal
description: A reservation transfer outside an approved proposal is refused; through one, the source is reduced and the target gains the same quantity.

name: purchase_invoice_auto_post
description: An agent-drafted invoice of a supplier with enough history matches its fully received order exactly; with the type live, tainted drafts enabled and the agent active, the gateway posts it as system and an auto_post_unconfirmed item asks the rule's owner to confirm.

name: purchase_invoice_price_variance
description: A line 5% above the order price with a 1% tolerance gets require_human, and auto_post_review names price_outside_auto_post_tolerance with both prices.

name: tainted_auto_post_disabled
description: The same clean invoice with auto_post.allow_tainted_drafts false gets require_human (auto_post_tainted_not_enabled); a direct change to true returns proposal_required.

name: llm_chosen_item_not_verified
description: A line whose item the LLM chose among candidates gets require_human (line_item_not_mapped); after the mapping proposal is approved, the supplier's next invoice posts.

name: plan_changed_before_execution
description: The goods receipt is reversed between simulation and execution; the execution returns plan_hash_mismatch, nothing posts, and the decision is require_human (auto_post_plan_changed).

name: wrong_auto_post_suspends_document_type
description: The owner confirms one auto-posted invoice as wrong; every enabled purchase invoice auto-post rule's evidence is outdated, auto_post_suspended is raised, and the next clean invoice gets require_human.

name: gateway_fail_closed
description: A decision table in force has no row for one case, and another case reads a setting with no value in force; both get require_human.

name: advisor_drafts_only
description: The advisor proposes thresholds and a table from six months of invoices; it drafts a table version and a change proposal and cannot submit, approve or enable them; its tool list excludes held-out cases.

name: duplicate_invoice_rejected
description: An agent drafts an invoice whose supplier invoice key is already posted; the simulation returns duplicate_external_document, the decision is reject, and the draft stays for a person.

name: quote_request_case_auto
description: With work_case.quote_request.mode auto, a matched customer e-mail opens one case; the tainted quotation run's draft and the later approval_pending item join it; a second raise for the same message adds nothing.

name: quote_request_clean_note_path
description: In the same case the salesperson's own note starts an untainted run that configures products; the case shows one tainted and one clean draft, and its taint summary counts one.

name: case_bulk_actions_separate
description: From a case a person submits two drafts and approves a third in one confirmation; three commands run with three keys and plan hashes; the approval of a draft that person wrote is refused with segregation_of_duties and stays in the case.

name: purchase_chain_sod_in_case
description: In a case, the approver of a purchase order tries to post its goods receipt from the case view and is refused with segregation_of_duties (purchase_order_vs_goods_receipt).

name: case_hidden_rows
description: A sales clerk opens a supplier_invoice case linked by an accountant; the invoice's cost fields and the purchase documents outside the clerk's scope are counted as hidden, never shown.

name: case_kind_off
description: With work_case.customer_issue.mode off, complaint_open opens no case and CreateWorkCase for that kind is refused with work_case_kind_not_enabled.

name: quickflows_setup_one_person
description: The only user of a new company acknowledges themself as implementer and applies quickflows with a risk amount, then sets ui.post_review_max_amount; ui.post_review on_exceptions and the maximum are recorded as setup loosenings without a second approver, the small-company mode is enabled, four policy rules are created, and setup_loosening_review is raised.

name: setup_path_closed_after_go_live
description: A migration's opening entries do not end the setup phase; after the first ordinary sales invoice posts, a setup-path loosening is refused with setup_phase_closed and a direct loosening returns proposal_required.

name: one_click_post_clean
description: Under quickflows a person posts a clean sales invoice below the post review maximum and the risk amount; the simulation returns no review reason, the client executes at once, the audit record has is_review_skipped, and the history shows the plan.

name: one_click_post_exception
description: The same person posts an invoice above the post review maximum, then a goods delivery with a negative-stock check result; both return review reasons and open the plan panel; a client that sends is_review_skipped anyway gets post_review_required and nothing is committed.

name: owner_approves_event_agent_draft
description: In the small-company mode the purchase invoice agent drafts an invoice from a supplier e-mail for the owner as workflow owner; the chief accountant clears its taint; the owner approves it above the risk amount and an own_agent_draft_approval exception is recorded; a draft from a run the owner started with their own note is refused with segregation_of_duties.

name: preset_drift_and_tighten
description: After quickflows the owner sets ui.post_review back to always at once (a tightening); ListSettingPresetDrift lists it, and the next post shows the plan panel.

name: self_clear_taint_small_company
description: In a one-person company with the small-company mode on, the owner clears the purchase invoice agent's tainted draft with a reason; an own_run_taint_clearance exception is recorded, the gateway still treats the draft as tainted (require_human), and a bulk clearance of two such drafts is refused with segregation_of_duties; with the mode off, the single clearance is refused with segregation_of_duties.

name: site_internal_transfer_neutral
description: At valuation level site, a transfer from a site's raw-materials warehouse to its production warehouse leaves the site's area value unchanged after period-end costing, while a transfer to a second site moves at the issuing site's average.

name: second_site_requires_choice
description: A one-site company creates a warehouse without naming a site and receives goods into it; after a second site is created, a warehouse created without a site is refused, and moving the stocked warehouse to the second site is refused.

name: resource_group_move_and_cost
description: An unconfirmed operation of a released order moves by change order to another member of its resource group; its confirmation is costed at the target's cost center and rates, and a further move after confirmation is refused.

name: payment_method_default_money_account
description: A USD sales invoice with a bank_transfer method drafts a bank receipt on the USD money account set for the invoice's branch; an invoice with a cash method drafts a cash receipt on the cash money account without a branch row.

name: carrier_on_delivery
description: A delivery copies the carrier of its sales order's carrier method, the carrier is changed before posting, and the tracking link is shown; a carrier partner without an active supplier role is refused.

name: business_unit_conflict_first_match
description: A delivery's cost-of-goods line for a product of unit A, from a site of unit B, on a sales order whose header names C: the line gets A with source item, and the entry's trace lists B and C as losing candidates.

name: business_unit_required_missing
description: With the requirement on and no default, a payment whose settlement posts a realized exchange difference is rejected with business_unit_missing; after the company default is set, it posts with source company_default.

name: business_unit_default_not_retroactive
description: A product's unit changes from A to B; the reversal of an invoice posted earlier keeps A (source reversal), a new invoice gets B, and net revenue by business unit shows both.

name: business_unit_expense_line
description: A purchase invoice expense line with a cost center of unit A gets A with source cost_center; a second line with an explicit unit D gets D with source line.

name: receipt_inspected_and_released
description: A receipt of 100 of an item with point goods_receipt posts to quality_inspection; a lot with sample 5 opens; the results pass and the inspector accepts; a status-change task releases 100, and on its confirmation the lot closes.

name: partial_rejection_to_supplier
description: A lot of 100 is rejected with 88 released, 10 returned and 2 destroyed samples; a draft return to supplier issues from quality_inspection, a draft internal consumption posts quality_sample, and a supplier nonconformance opens a work case.

name: auto_accept_with_and_without_rule
description: With the auto_accept setting and the plan flag on, complete passing results lead system to submit an accepted decision; without an allow rule for system it waits for approval; with one it is approved; one failing result stops the draft.

name: certificate_results_need_confirmation
description: A supplier certificate extraction drafts results for the matching lot; SubmitInspectionLot returns inspection_result_unconfirmed; after ConfirmInspectionResult it succeeds; a certificate matching no single open lot raises certificate_unmatched.

name: output_rework_and_make_to_order
description: Rejected make-to-order output gets a draft rework order issuing from quality_inspection; the reworked output's lot is accepted, and its release reserves the output for the sales line.

name: held_stock_moved_outside_lot
description: While a lot of 100 is open, 10 units of its key are scrapped directly; a decision over 100 returns inspection_stock_short; a decision over 90 with a deviation reason succeeds.

name: source_reversed
description: A production receipt is reversed while its lot is a draft and the lot is canceled by system; after the lot is approved and released, the reversal is refused with negative_stock until the stock is moved back.

name: in_process_rejection
description: An operation confirmation of an operation named by a released in_process plan opens a lot without stock; its rejection has no lines and opens an internal nonconformance.

name: wo_many_postings
description: An MO of 100 with two WOs: op 10 is started, paused with a stop reason, started again, confirmed for 40 with activities proposed from the logs and one adjusted, then scrap 2, then 58 final; receipts of 40, 30 and 28; an issue above requirement; costing reads only the confirmations.

name: mo_without_operations_scrap
description: An MO without routing gets two issues, three receipts and receipt scrap of 4 with a reason; backflush at receipt follows max(R / G, (R + S) / Q); receipt scrap on an MO with an internal operation is refused.

name: wo_transfer_in_resource_group
description: A WO moves to a sibling work center before start; its reservations point to the new supply bin; the confirmation carries the new work center and pool allocation counts it; a transfer after start and one outside the group are refused.

name: capture_agent_time_logs
description: The capture agent drafts time logs and a confirmation from a shift sheet; the logs are not proposed until a person confirms them; the tainted run's StartOperation is refused.

name: machine_signal_start_pause
description: An integration starts and pauses a WO from machine signals while two operators log run time with overlaps; machine time is the union of the intervals and labor time the person logs times head count.

name: blocked_wo_case
description: A WO is blocked for a breakdown; operation_blocked is raised and, with work_case.production_disruption.mode auto, a case opens; StartOperation closes the item.

name: final_with_open_log
description: A final confirmation while a run log is open is refused; the tablet's batch pauses the WO first and succeeds, and the stop log left open is closed at posting.

name: reversal_reopens_logs
description: Reversing a final confirmation makes its logs unconfirmed and the WO no longer done; the next confirmation proposes the logs again.

name: costing_sheet_rows
description: A sheet with base rows for material and conversion, a 10% material overhead, an amount per machine hour, an amount per output unit and a subtotal; the estimate's surcharge lines land in their details and credit their cost centers; the lines sum to the total.

name: costing_rate_conditions
description: Rates with no condition, for an item group, and for a site and that item group; an item of the group at that site takes the third, at another site the second, of another group the first.

name: costing_rate_missing_gap
description: A percent row without a valid rate on the costing date gives costing_rate_missing; the total leaves it out and release is refused; after the rate is set the estimate is computed again and released; a stored rate 0 is no gap.

name: selling_rows_quote_only
description: Administration and selling rows appear in GetSellingPriceCosting for a quotation and never in the released estimate, the preliminary price or the below-cost check.

name: version_sheet_override
description: A production version with its own costing sheet costs with it, another version of the site with the site's; with production.costing_sheet.required true, a site without a sheet gives costing_sheet_missing.

name: detail_rollup_two_periods
description: An order open across a period end with raw material, packaging, labor and an unmapped overhead account; the detail rows sum exactly to the four components in both periods, the unmapped cost lands in the default overhead detail, and the second period opens with the first's closing split.

name: projected_cost_at_completion
description: An order completed in a period without receipts shows its projected final cost with that period's cost as projected residual; after a reopen and a further receipt the projection is in progress again; after the run it equals the settled actuals and is no longer provisional.

name: agent_drafts_costing_sheet
description: The production agent's direct SetCostingSheetRates is refused with proposal_required; its proposal, with rates from GetCostingRateSuggestion, executes after a person approves.

name: invoice_head_office_and_payer
description: An order with a ship-to site, a head-office bill-to party and a paying group: the delivery goes to the site, the invoice and its tax carry the head office, the open item and the credit exposure the group.

name: party_defaults_from_relationships
description: A partner with one default ship-to and no payer relationship gets the ship-to on a new order and no payer; changing the default does not touch an existing order.

name: party_stale_snapshot
description: A bill-to party's address changes after the order; posting the invoice returns partner_snapshot_stale for that party.

name: external_id_reimport
description: A web-shop customer imported twice with the same key updates the partner; a second key for the same partner in that source system is refused with external_id_conflict.

name: custom_field_required_and_retired
description: A required custom field refuses a new order without a value; after it is retired, existing orders keep and show the value and refuse a change.

name: custom_field_restricted_actor
description: A custom field of class cost is absent from the responses, plans and events of an actor without the class.

name: cancel_with_reason
description: A quotation canceled with a reason of kind cancel and a note; a reason of another kind or an inactive one is refused with reason_invalid.

name: scrap_reason_needs_scrap
description: A production receipt or confirmation with a scrap reason and no scrap quantity is refused.

name: header_note_frozen
description: A note written on a draft is part of its version and cannot change after posting; the journal entry carries a copy.

name: payee_change_by_proposal
description: An agent that changes a supplier's payee relationship directly is refused with proposal_required; its proposal executes after a person approves.

name: count_summed_counting_units
description: One count key entered in three lines in cartons and pieces: the lines sum in the inventory unit and one difference posts.

name: count_uncounted_key_posts_nothing
description: A bin with two items where one is counted: the other posts nothing; a counted zero posts a shortage.

name: count_picks_after_freeze
description: A pick between the freeze and the posting is not a difference: the posted difference is the counted quantity minus the stored book quantity.

name: count_reversal_refused_when_consumed
description: A surplus count whose stock was shipped cannot be reversed.

name: count_shortage_cancels_reservation
description: A count shortage that cuts into a reservation posts, cancels the reservation deterministically and raises an exception.

name: transfer_through_transit_short_receipt
description: A dispatch of 10 is received as 8; 2 remain in the transit warehouse; the dispatch cannot be reversed before its receive.

name: transfer_reversal_refused_after_shipment
description: A direct transfer whose goods were delivered is not reversible.

name: scrap_from_held_status
description: Held goods are scrapped from blocked with a reason; a scrap that would cut into a reservation is refused with stock_reserved.

name: consumption_one_bearer
description: An internal consumption naming both a cost center and a project, or neither, is refused; a quality sample may name neither.

name: scrap_without_reason
description: A scrap line without a reason of kind scrap, or with a reason of another kind, is refused.
